title: PJMFreeLook
description: PJM: FreeLook — Immersive free-look system inspired by Arma and Squad. Look around independently from your body’s movement! 🛡️👀 Includes flexible config for tactical awareness. ⚙️👟
body:
🛡️ PJM: FreeLook

PJM: FreeLook brings tactical situational awareness to Minecraft by adding a flexible, immersive free-look system inspired by military simulators like Arma 3 and Squad. 🎮
🚀 Features:

    👀 Independent Head Movement: Look around your surroundings without changing your character's movement direction. Scan for threats while staying on track.

    🎖️ Tactical Immersion: Perfect for mil-sim enthusiasts and tactical combat scenarios.

    ⚙️ Highly Customizable: Fully adjustable settings. Fine-tune sensitivity, toggle/hold modes, and camera limits to fit your playstyle.

    ✨ Smooth Transitions: Fluid and responsive camera movement for a natural feel.

Take control of your vision. Keep your boots moving forward and your eyes on the horizon! 🧭
